release.changelog: Initial OMDSH submission for the V0.9 Developer Technical Preview: governed GitHub task authority, explicit lifecycle tools, RUNNING-only mutation guard, governed-builder Skill, evidence recording, tracked prebuilt lib for scripts-disabled Profile Bundle intake, and author-facing release-truth convergence.

management.label: DeepSeek Harness Profile Bundle
management.instructions: Use the DSH Profile Bundle mechanism with the exact pinned package spec declared in release.profileBundle.spec. Activation requires a profile restart.

declarations.permissions: Registers DSH model-facing lifecycle tools, a governed-builder Skill, a ToolRuntime mutation guard, and appends Session governance evidence. The default bundle performs no network request; the opt-in public GitHub Issue authority provider may perform one fixed-host unauthenticated GitHub.com read. No credential lookup, subprocess execution, or native-code loading is part of the declared plugin runtime behavior.
declarations.testing: Author-side evidence: repository CI at OMDSH-1 acceptance covered 167 tests across 12 files plus TypeScript typecheck, canonical build, and fail-closed tracked-lib drift checking. Scripts-disabled Profile Bundle install, dump-config, normal boot, real governance_status invocation, remove, and reinstall were also recorded in docs/OMDSH_REVIEW.md. These are author-side facts, not OMDSH certification.

capability.invocation: invoke the model-facing tool named governance_status with empty arguments through the DSH ToolRuntime
capability.expected: a bounded read-only object with fields state (lifecycle state), authorityAccepted (boolean), taskId (string|null), and a last-transition summary
